newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's Benetton expects big acquisition in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Benetton expects big acquisition in 1997.

text.p: Italy's Luciano Benetton was quoted on Saturday as saying that his Benetton clothing group would make a key acquisition by year-end to help increase its global turnover.
The northeastern company had already said last month that it was carrying out feasibility studies into a possible acquisition in the firm's core clothing sector.

Benetton, who is president of his family's company, told financial daily Il Sole 24 Ore that the move was necessary because clothing firms were forced to keep growing in order to stand up to increasing global competition.
"Size will win: large-scale distribution and big commercial spaces have paved a way that is now compulsory for everyone," Benetton said.

"We will have to carry out an important acquisition in the sector that will allow us to augment our critical mass. We are working on it and I think we'll complete the operation by the end of the year," he said. -- Rome newsroom +396 6782505
